messages:
maria_support: FYI forwarding an Acme report — they say outputs changed after last night's rollout, parser downstream started failing :frowning: 
acme_jenna: Hi — yes, we started seeing a subtle change where our automated parser that expects 'CONFIRM: <YES/NO>' now gets 'CONFIRM:<YES/NO>' (no space). Worked fine before. Rolling back fixes it.
acme_jenna: Minimal repro we use:
```http
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <key>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-chat-3b",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that prefixes CONFIRM: before final answer."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Please confirm: are you online?"}
  ]
}
```
acme_jenna: Response (before rollout):
```
{"id":"resp_abc123","choices":[{"message":{"content":"CONFIRM: YES"}}]}
```
acme_jenna: Response (after rollout):
```
{"id":"resp_def456","choices":[{"message":{"content":"CONFIRM:YES"}}]}
```
acme_jenna: This breaks our downstream regex which expects 'CONFIRM: ' with a trailing space. Request ids above from customer logs.
maria_support: thanks. any headers/region info? token counts?
acme_jenna: region: us-west-2, header x-rwd-version: 2026-03-16. token usage logged as 18 tokens for both. We also saw differences when prompt contains leading NBSP or when system message ended with "---".
lee_eng_ml: curious — could be tokenizer whitespace normalization or chat template trimming. Did the system->assistant delimiter change in the rollout?
acme_jenna: We didn't touch prompts. We only upgraded client lib, but issue reproduced with raw HTTP.
alex_se: @lee_eng_ml adding request ids to internal trace: resp_def456 and resp_abc123. Also pinging deploybot — which deploys went out around that time?
deploybot: rollout rwd-chat-runtime v1.18 -> v1.19 completed 2026-03-16T22:12:03Z (canary->prod). Noted tokenizer package bumped: tokenizers@0.9.1 -> 0.9.3 in model-serving image.
lee_eng_ml: OK that maps. My hunch: tokenizers 0.9.3 introduced a merge rule that strips a single ascii space when joining subtoken boundaries after punctuation. That would turn 'CONFIRM: YES' -> 'CONFIRM:YES' in some cases. Can you attach exact byte payloads? we need raw utf-8 bytes around the colon and space.
acme_jenna: Attached (pasted below) — we confirmed bytes are 0x43 0x4F 0x4E 0x46 0x49 0x52 0x4D 0x3A 0x20 0x59 0x45 0x53 (so colon + regular space).
lee_eng_ml: thanks. I'll try to reproduce locally with the same model & tokenizers@0.9.3 + runtime changes. If repro, plan: revert tokenizer bump or apply a compatibility patch to maintain previous join behavior.
maria_support: timeline for rollback if needed? this is breaking customer parsing.
lee_eng_ml: if repros, we can push hotfix to canary within 2 hours, full rollback in 6 hours. I'll post updates here.
acme_jenna: appreciate the fast turnaround. Also happy to share additional failing samples.
lee_eng_ml: (next steps) 1) reproduce with tokenizers@0.9.3 2) add unit test that asserts 'CONFIRM: YES' stays with space 3) patch runtime splitting logic 4) deploy.
alex_se: flagging for SEs: customers using strict regex parsing might need a heads-up in changelog.
maria_support: noted, will reach out to other affected customers after confirm. :thumbsup:
